lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਸਿਰਜੀਆ ਆਪੇ ਫੁਨਿ ਗੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tudh aape sisat sirajeeaa aape phun goee ||
lines.translation: You Yourself created the world, and You Yourself shall destroy it in the end.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਇਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh iko sabad varatadaa jo kare s hoee ||
lines.translation: The Word of Your Shabad alone is pervading everywhere; whatever You do, comes to pass.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadiaaee guramukh dei prabh har paavai soee ||
lines.translation: God blesses the Gurmukh with glorious greatness, and then, he finds the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਸਭਿ ਆਖਹੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੨੯॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ
lines.transliteration: guramukh naanak aaraadhiaa sabh aakhahu dha(n)n dha(n)n dha(n)n gur soee ||29||1|| sudh
lines.translation: As Gurmukh, Nanak worships and adores the Lord; let everyone proclaim, "Blessed, blessed, blessed is He, the Guru!" ||29||1||Sudh||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag sorath baanee bhagat kabeer jee kee ghar 1 ||
lines.translation: Raag Sorat'h, The Word Of Devotee Kabeer Jee, First House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੁਤ ਪੂਜਿ ਪੂਜਿ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੂਏ ਤੁਰਕ ਮੂਏ ਸਿਰੁ ਨਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: but pooj pooj hi(n)doo mooe turak mooe sir naaee ||
lines.translation: Worshipping their idols, the Hindus die; the Muslims die bowing their heads.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਲੇ ਜਾਰੇ ਓਇ ਲੇ ਗਾਡੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਦੁਹੂ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: oi le jaare oi le gaade teree gat duhoo na paaee ||1||
lines.translation: The Hindus cremate their dead, while the Muslims bury theirs; neither finds Your true state, Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਅੰਧ ਗਹੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: man re sa(n)saar a(n)dh gaheraa ||
lines.translation: O mind, the world is a deep, dark pit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸ ਪਸਰਿਓ ਹੈ ਜਮ ਜੇਵਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: chahu dis pasario hai jam jevaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: On all four sides, Death has spread his net. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬਿਤ ਪੜੇ ਪੜਿ ਕਬਿਤਾ ਮੂਏ ਕਪੜ ਕੇਦਾਰੈ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabit paRe paR kabitaa mooe kapaR kedaarai jaaee ||
lines.translation: Reciting their poems, the poets die; the mystical ascetics die while journeying to Kaydaar Naat'h.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਟਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਮੂਏ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਇਨਹਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jataa dhaar dhaar jogee mooe teree gat inahi na paaee ||2||
lines.translation: The Yogis die, with their matted hair, but even they do not find Your state, Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਬੁ ਸੰਚਿ ਸੰਚਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਮੂਏ ਗਡਿ ਲੇ ਕੰਚਨ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: darab sa(n)ch sa(n)ch raaje mooe gad le ka(n)chan bhaaree ||
lines.translation: The kings die, gathering and hoarding their money, burying great quantities of gold.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੜੇ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੂਏ ਰੂਪੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: bed paRe paR pa(n)dit mooe roop dekh dekh naaree ||3||
lines.translation: The Pandits die, reading and reciting the Vedas; women die, gazing at their own beauty. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਭੈ ਬਿਗੂਤੇ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਨਿਰਖਿ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam bin sabhai bigoote dekhahu nirakh sareeraa ||
lines.translation: Without the Lord's Name, all come to ruin; behold, and know this, O body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਨਿ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਕਹਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਬੀਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har ke naam bin kin gat paaee kahi upades kabeeraa ||4||1||
lines.translation: Without the Name of the Lord, who can find salvation? Kabeer speaks the Teachings. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਜਰੀਐ ਤਬ ਹੋਇ ਭਸਮ ਤਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਕਿਰਮ ਦਲ ਖਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab jareeai tab hoi bhasam tan rahai kiram dal khaaee ||
lines.translation: When the body is burnt, it turns to ashes; if it is not cremated, then it is eaten by armies of worms.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਚੀ ਗਾਗਰਿ ਨੀਰੁ ਪਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਇਆ ਤਨ ਕੀ ਇਹੈ ਬਡਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kaachee gaagar neer parat hai iaa tan kee ihai badaaee ||1||
lines.translation: The unbaked clay pitcher dissolves, when water is poured into it; this is also the nature of the body. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਭਈਆ ਫਿਰਤੌ ਫੂਲਿਆ ਫੂਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaahe bhaeeaa phiratau phooliaa phooliaa ||
lines.translation: Why, O Siblings of Destiny, do you strut around, all puffed up with pride?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਦਸ ਮਾਸ ਉਰਧ ਮੁਖ ਰਹਤਾ ਸੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਭੂਲਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab das maas uradh mukh rahataa so din kaise bhooliaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Have you forgotten those days, when you were hanging, face down, for ten months? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮਧੁ ਮਾਖੀ ਤਿਉ ਸਠੋਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਜੋਰਿ ਜੋਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu madh maakhee tiu sathor ras jor jor dhan keeaa ||
lines.translation: Like the bee which collects honey, the fool eagerly gathers and collects wealth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਰਤੀ ਬਾਰ ਲੇਹੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਕਰੀਐ ਭੂਤੁ ਰਹਨ ਕਿਉ ਦੀਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: maratee baar lehu lehu kareeai bhoot rahan kiu deeaa ||2||
lines.translation: At the time of death, they shout, "Take him away, take him away! Why leave a ghost lying around?" ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਲਉ ਬਰੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਈ ਆਗੈ ਸਜਨ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: dehuree lau baree naar sa(n)g bhaee aagai sajan suhelaa ||
lines.translation: His wife accompanies him to the threshold, and his friends and companions beyond.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਰਘਟ ਲਉ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਗੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਭਇਓ ਆਗੈ ਹੰਸੁ ਅਕੇਲਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: maraghat lau sabh log kuta(n)b bhaio aagai ha(n)s akelaa ||3||
lines.translation: All the people and relatives go as far as the cremation grounds, and then, the soul-swan goes on alone. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਪਰੇ ਕਾਲ ਗ੍ਰਸ ਕੂਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer sunahu re praanee pare kaal gras kooaa ||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, listen, O mortal being: you have been seized by Death, and you have fallen into the deep, dark pit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਆਪੁ ਬੰਧਾਇਆ ਜਿਉ ਨਲਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਸੂਆ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jhoothee maaiaa aap ba(n)dhaaiaa jiu nalanee bhram sooaa ||4||2||
lines.translation: You have entangled yourself in the false wealth of Maya, like the parrot caught in the trap. ||4||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਭੈ ਮਤ ਸੁਨਿ ਕੈ ਕਰੀ ਕਰਮ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bed puraan sabhai mat sun kai karee karam kee aasaa ||
lines.translation: Listening to all the teachings of the Vedas and the Puraanas, I wanted to perform the religious rituals.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਲ ਗ੍ਰਸਤ ਸਭ ਲੋਗ ਸਿਆਨੇ ਉਠਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੈ ਚਲੇ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kaal grasat sabh log siaane uth pa(n)dit pai chale niraasaa ||1||
lines.translation: But seeing all the wise men caught by Death, I arose and left the Pandits; now I am free of this desire. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਰਿਓ ਨ ਏਕੈ ਕਾਜਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: man re sario na ekai kaajaa ||
lines.translation: O mind, you have not completed the only task you were given;

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਜਿਓ ਨ ਰਘੁਪਤਿ ਰਾਜਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhajio na raghupat raajaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: you have not meditated on the Lord, your King. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਨ ਖੰਡ ਜਾਇ ਜੋਗੁ ਤਪੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲੁ ਚੁਨਿ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ban kha(n)d jaai jog tap keeno ka(n)d mool chun khaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Going to the forests, they practice Yoga and deep, austere meditation; they live on roots and the fruits they gather.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਦੀ ਬੇਦੀ ਸਬਦੀ ਮੋਨੀ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਪਟੈ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naadee bedee sabadee monee jam ke patai likhaaiaa ||2||
lines.translation: The musicians, the Vedic scholars, the chanters of one word and the men of silence, all are listed on the Register of Death. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਨਾਰਦੀ ਰਿਦੈ ਨ ਆਈ ਕਾਛਿ ਕੂਛਿ ਤਨੁ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat naaradee ridai na aaee kaachh koochh tan deenaa ||
lines.translation: Loving devotional worship does not enter into your heart; pampering and adorning your body, you must still give it up.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗ ਰਾਗਨੀ ਡਿੰਭ ਹੋਇ ਬੈਠਾ ਉਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਲੀਨਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: raag raaganee di(n)bh hoi baithaa un har pahi kiaa leenaa ||3||
lines.translation: You sit and play music, but you are still a hypocrite; what do you expect to receive from the Lord? ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਿਓ ਕਾਲੁ ਸਭੈ ਜਗ ਊਪਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pario kaal sabhai jag oopar maahi likhe bhram giaanee ||
lines.translation: Death has fallen on the whole world; the doubting religious scholars are also listed on the Register of Death.
